chunks: This visitation is narrated by al-Hasan ibn Rashid from al-Husayn ibn Thuwair from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him).

Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: 'When you come to Abu Abdullah al-Husayn (peace be upon him), perform ghusl on the bank of the Euphrates, then wear pure clothes, then walk barefoot, for you are in a sanctuary of Allah, the Mighty and Exalted, and the sanctuary of His Messenger, peace be upon him and his family. Engage abundantly in takbir, tahlil, tamjid, and ta'zim for Allah, and send blessings upon Muhammad and his family, peace be upon them, until you reach the gate of the shrine. Then say: Peace be upon you, O proof of Allah and son of His proof. Peace be upon you, O angels of Allah and visitors to the grave of the son of the Prophet of Allah.'

Then take ten steps, then stand and say 'Allahu Akbar' thirty times, then walk towards him until you reach him from the front. Face him with your face, and place the Qibla between your shoulders. Then say: Peace be upon you, O proof of Allah and son of His proof.

Peace be upon you, O avenged by Allah on earth and son of His avenger. Peace be upon you, O solitary one of Allah, avenged in the heavens and the earth. I bear witness that your blood resides in eternity, causing the canopies of the Throne to tremble, and all creation wept for you. The seven heavens, the seven earths, all within and between them, and all beings in Paradise and Hell, both seen and unseen, wept for you.

I bear witness that you are the proof of Allah and the son of His proof. I bear witness that you are the avenger of Allah and the son of His avenger. I bear witness that you are the solitary one of Allah, avenged in the heavens and the earth. I bear witness that you conveyed from Allah, advised sincerely, fulfilled and completed, and struggled in the path of your Lord. You departed as a witness, a martyr, a witness, and testified against.

I am the servant of Allah and your master, in your obedience. I am the visitor to you, seeking thereby the highest rank with Allah, the Mighty and Exalted, and steadfastness in migration to you, and the path that cannot be replaced, by entering your guardianship, as commanded. Whoever seeks Allah begins with you. Whoever seeks Allah begins with you. Whoever seeks Allah begins with you.

Through you, Allah reveals falsehood. Through you, Allah distances the age of deceit. Through you, Allah opens and concludes. Through you, 'Allah erases whatever He wills' and affirms. Through you, Allah removes disgrace from our necks. Through you, Allah avenges every wrong suffered by believing men and women. Through you, the earth grows its trees, the trees bear their fruits, the heavens send down their rain, Allah lifts anguish, and rain descends.

Through you, the earth that carries your bodies glorifies Allah. Cursed is the nation that killed you, the nation that opposed you, the nation that denied your guardianship, the nation that fought against you, and the nation that witnessed and did not support you. All praise belongs to Allah who made the Fire their abode. 'What an evil destination to arrive at.' 'What an evil place to return to.' 'And all praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds.'

May Allah bless you, O Abu Abdullah. I declare my disavowal before Allah from those who opposed you. I declare my disavowal before Allah from those who opposed you. I declare my disavowal before Allah from those who opposed you.

Then go to Ali, his son, peace be upon him, who is at his feet, and say: Peace be upon you, O son of the Messenger of Allah. Peace be upon you, O son of Ali, Commander of the Faithful. Peace be upon you, O son of Hasan and Husayn. Peace be upon you, O son of Khadijah and Fatimah, peace be upon her.

May Allah bless you. May Allah bless you. May Allah bless you. May Allah curse those who killed you. May Allah curse those who killed you. May Allah curse those who killed you. I declare my disavowal before Allah from them. I declare my disavowal before Allah from them. I declare my disavowal before Allah from them.

Then stand and gesture with your hand towards the martyrs and say: Peace be upon you. Peace be upon you. Peace be upon you. You have succeeded, by Allah. You have succeeded, by Allah. You have succeeded, by Allah. Would that I were with you, 'so that I could achieve a great success.'
Then turn and place the grave of Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) before you, and pray six units of prayer. With that, your visitation is complete.

key_terms.الْحَائِرِ: The shrine or enclosure of the Imam

ai.seo_question: What are the ritual steps and supplications for visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn (as) according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This Ziyarah from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih* emphasizes the spiritual purification and cosmic significance of visiting Imam al-Husayn (as), framing his martyrdom as a divine proof (Hujjah) that resonates through the heavens and earth. The ritual prescribes specific preparatory acts like ghusl on the Euphrates and barefoot walking to signify humility, culminating in a declaration of allegiance and six units of prayer that solidify the visitor’s connection to the Ahl al-Bayt. It serves as a comprehensive guide for embodying the status of 'Thar Allah' (Avenger of God) through both physical devotion and theological affirmation.
